journey.name: Deck requests — asking for a deck nobody has made, from the four places that run out
journey.description:
A reader with nothing to study can post a request to their pubky.app feed, labelled "loopky" and "deck-request" (Architecture.md §7.7 point 5b). One sheet behind four entry points: the empty Home, a search with no deck matches, a topic with no decks, and the foot of Discover once browse has no more pages. Each prefills what came up empty.
Needs a signed-in session (journey 01 or 20) on an account with NO decks, owned or followed, for the Home step; the rest work on any account. A guest pass needs a signed-out install. Requests are public posts: use a staging account, and delete what you post afterwards.

actions.action: On an account with no decks, verify Home shows the empty card with "home_discover", "home_create_deck" and, under them, "home_request_deck" reading "Can’t find one? Request a deck"
Tap "home_request_deck" and verify a sheet "deck_request_sheet" titled "Request a deck" opens with an EMPTY "deck_request_input", a "0/280" counter, and "deck_request_submit" disabled

Type "ab" and verify "deck_request_submit" is still disabled. Type "Japanese hiragana for beginners" instead and verify it enables, the counter follows, and "deck_request_preview" reads "I’d love a Loopky deck about:", a blank line, then exactly what was typed, with "loopky" and "deck-request" chips under it
Tap "deck_request_submit" and verify a spinner, then "deck_request_sent" reading "Request posted". Tap "deck_request_done" and verify the sheet closes on Home
Verify the post is on the account's pubky.app feed with both tags, and listed by the indexer under /v0/search/posts/by_tag/deck-request

Open Discover and type a query no deck matches (e.g. "zzqx hiragana") into "search_input". Verify "search_empty" and, under it, "search_request_deck". Tap its button "deck_request_cta" and verify the sheet opens OVER the search results with the query already in "deck_request_input"
Swipe the sheet down and verify nothing was posted and the search results are still there
Search for a query that matches PEOPLE but no deck, and verify "search_request_deck" is still offered under the people

On Discover, select a topic chip whose browse comes back empty (or two chips no deck shares) and verify "discover_browse_empty" with "discover_request_deck" under it; tapping it prefills the topic label(s)
Clear the topic and scroll browse until "browse_more" stops appearing, and verify "discover_request_deck" sits at the very foot of the list, with an empty prefill

OFFLINE. With the network cut, post a request and verify "deck_request_error" says why, the text is kept, and "deck_request_submit" is enabled again. Restore the network, tap it, and verify ONE post on the feed, not two

GUEST. Signed out, open search or Discover's foot and tap "deck_request_cta": verify "sign_in_prompt" titled "Request a deck" opens INSTEAD of the sheet, and "sign_in_prompt_dismiss" leaves the screen as it was
TABLET. At expanded width verify the sheet is width-capped and centred, not 1280dp of text field, and the Discover callout spans the deck grid's pane
DARK. With the dark theme verify the callout card, the preview box and the sheet are legible
